title: Completion of the guide allocation
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with $k$ work tapes, let $a \in \mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a finite word over the schedule alphabet. For any base configuration on $x$, input-head position $p$, integer budget-head position $b$, and budget tape contents $\beta$, let $n,B \in \mathbb{N}$ satisfy $n+1 \le B$. Starting from the setup configuration in the unary-start phase with unary head at $B+1$ over the unary tape with $B$ markers, unary head contents as specified by that tape, and guide head at $0$ over the partial guide with $n+1$ copied cells, after exactly $14B+10$ steps the machine is in the macrostep-check phase, with unary head at $1$ over the same unary tape and guide head at $0$ over the guide of radius $3B$; the clock tapes, budget tape and head, input-head position, and output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: W is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
x is a finite word over the schedule alphabet
budget-head position b and contents β
n and B are natural numbers
replaced:
Let $n + 1 \le B$.  From a setup configuration in the unary-start phase with unary head
at cell $B+1$ over the unary tape with $B$ markers and guide head at cell $0$ over the
partial guide with $n+1$ copied cells, exactly $14B + 10$ steps produce the completed
guide of radius $3B$ and enter the macrostep-check phase with unary head at cell $1$
and guide head at cell $0$; the budget tape and head and the parked input head are
unchanged.
